title: Persian Rice with Broad Beans and Dill
subtitle: with a crisp potato base
description: Parboiled basmati rice layered over a golden potato crust, mixed with broad beans and dill, and steamed until the base can be turned out whole.

steps.text: Boil water in a medium pot. Rinse the rice under running water until the water runs clear, then cook it for 5 minutes, drain and rinse with cold water.
In another pot, blanch the broad beans for a few seconds, just until the water returns to the boil. Drain, rinse in plenty of cold water and peel off the clear outer skins.
Mix one third of the rice with salt, pepper, turmeric and 1/4 cup olive oil.

Grease a deep non-stick pot with olive oil and arrange the potato slices (0.5 cm thick) over the base. Cover with the seasoned rice and press down firmly. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then lower the heat and cook for 5 more minutes until golden.
Mix the remaining rice with the chopped dill, salt, pepper and broad beans and add to the pot, leaving a 1 cm border of the base exposed and piling the rice in a mound in the centre.

Poke steam holes in the rice. Mix 1/3 cup boiling water with 1/4 cup olive oil, salt and pepper and pour over the rice. Cover the pot with a towel-wrapped lid and cook on low heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Rest the pot on a bench for 10 minutes so the base sets and releases whole, then turn it out onto a plate and serve.
